headline: 1,579 severely malnourished children identified in Tumakuru over three years, with cases steadily increasing
summary: Tumakuru district identified 1,579 severely malnourished children over three years through monthly health check-ups at 4,199 anganwadis. In 2023–24 alone, 899 of 127,660 children screened were found underweight or stunted. Koratagere, Madhugiri, and Pavagada taluks show more cases. A local study found significant undernutrition among children aged 6 months to 6 years in urban Tumkur anganwadis. Maternal anaemia remains a concern, with 50% of women in Pavagada taluk battling anaemia, compounding malnutrition risks for children.

4,199 anganwadis conduct monthly health check-ups monitoring height and weight; 127,660 children screened in 2023–24

modelFactorWhy.factor: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
modelFactorWhy.why: While maternal anaemia is documented as severe in Pavagada taluk (50% prevalence, some with counts less than half normal), the pages do not specifically mention iron-folic acid supplementation compliance or duration in Tumakuru district.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Iron-folic acid supplementation during pregnancy prevents maternal anaemia, which directly affects fetal growth and birth weight, reducing stunting risk in children.

proof.claim: 50% of women in Pavagada taluk have anaemia, with poverty and healthcare access limiting treatment

modelFactorWhy.why: The pages discuss anganwadi attendance and nutrition programmes for children 6 months to 6 years but do not provide data on school enrollment rates for children aged 3–6 in Tumakuru district.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: School enrollment for young children indicates family stability, resources, and parental education levels, which correlate with better nutrition practices and growth monitoring.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Household members covered by health insurance
modelFactorWhy.why: Pavagada taluk shows unaffordable healthcare and difficulty accessing health centres as barriers. However, specific health insurance coverage rates for households are not mentioned in the pages.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Health insurance coverage enables families to afford preventive care, treatment for childhood illnesses, and maternal health services, all reducing malnutrition risk.

proof.claim: Poverty, unaffordable healthcare and difficulty accessing health centres contribute to low haemoglobin in Pavagada taluk
